verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a design platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry, usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. The self-hosting and data-privacy claims ("Penpot will never make business out of your data", "decide who has access to it") are about where data is hosted and who can reach it. They do not describe a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so they cannot be credited here.
